title: Stress: entry one bar late (approximate)
question: What if every fill came one 5-minute bar after the engine's fill?
verdict: Approximate (same exits): 680 of 768 trades keep a valid entry; 2026 +16,614 (PF 3.07), 2021-25 +6,244 (PF 1.09). No engine option exists for a delayed entry, so the exits are not re-simulated.
notes: Fill = open of the bar after the engine's fill bar + 1 tick; stop/target unchanged; micros from the new stop distance with the same cold/late multiplier; exit price and time kept. Trades whose late fill would be through the stop or past the target are dropped.

params.method: re-priced on the real bars, exits kept

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
